# Vendored libraries

Served from the shop itself, so the map needs no CDN. Each folder keeps its
licence file, as the licences require.

| Folder | Library | Version | Licence | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `maplibre/` | MapLibre GL JS | 6.11.2 | BSD-3-Clause | npm `maplibre-gl`, `dist/` |
| `pmtiles/` | PMTiles | 4.5.0 | BSD-3-Clause | npm `pmtiles`, `dist/pmtiles.js` |

To update one, replace the files from the new npm version and change the
version here and in the CHANGELOG.
